# Tax Foundation

> Independent nonprofit research organization providing principled, data-driven analysis of tax policy at federal, state, global, and European levels.

Tax Foundation operates three primary policy centers (Federal, State, and Global) and publishes authoritative competitiveness indices, interactive tax calculators, and comprehensive policy analysis. The organization combines macroeconomic modeling with expert research to inform tax reform debates and policy decisions.

## Research Centers & Core Resources

- [Research](https://taxfoundation.org/research): Tax Foundation research hub with three policy centers
- [Center for Federal Tax Policy](https://taxfoundation.org/research/federal-tax): Center for Federal Tax Policy research and analysis
- [Center for State Tax Policy](https://taxfoundation.org/research/state-tax): Center for State Tax Policy research and competitiveness index
- [Center for Global Tax Policy](https://taxfoundation.org/research/global-tax): Center for Global Tax Policy and international competitiveness
- [Tax Foundation Europe](https://taxfoundation.org/eu): Tax Foundation Europe division hub for EU tax policy research
- [Resource Center: All Tax Foundation Research & Data](https://taxfoundation.org/all-research-data): Comprehensive database of Tax Foundation research and tools
- [Tax Foundation Experts](https://taxfoundation.org/about-us/staff-and-board/experts): Tax Foundation expert staff directory and profiles

## Competitiveness Indices & Benchmarks

- [2026 State Tax Competitiveness Index](https://taxfoundation.org/research/all/state/2026-state-tax-competitiveness-index): 2026 State Tax Competitiveness Index with rankings and analysis
- [International Tax Competitiveness Index 2025](https://taxfoundation.org/research/all/global/2025-international-tax-competitiveness-index): 2025 International Tax Competitiveness Index for OECD countries
- [European Tax Policy Scorecard](https://taxfoundation.org/eu/research/european-tax-policy-scorecard): European Tax Policy Scorecard comparing EU member tax systems
- [EU Tax Research](https://taxfoundation.org/research/global-tax/eu-tax): EU tax policy research and European Tax Policy Scorecard

## Federal Tax Policy Analysis & Tools

- [Big Beautiful Bill Explained: Tax Changes FAQ](https://taxfoundation.org/research/all/federal/one-big-beautiful-bill-act-tax-changes): FAQ guide explaining One Big Beautiful Bill Act tax changes
- [2026 Tax Calculator | One Big Beautiful Bill Tax Calculator](https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/federal/tax-calculator-obbba): Interactive 2026 tax calculator for One Big Beautiful Bill
- [Tariff Tracker: 2026 Trump Tariffs & Trade War by the Numbers](https://taxfoundation.org/research/all/federal/trump-tariffs-trade-war): Analysis of 2026 Trump tariffs and trade policy impacts
- [Growth and Opportunity Tax Reform Plan](https://taxfoundation.org/research/all/federal/growth-opportunity-us-tax-reform-plan): Analysis of Tax Foundation's Growth and Opportunity tax plan

## State Tax Policy & Analysis

- [Remote Work Tax Reform: Improving Tax Mobility and Tax Modernization](https://taxfoundation.org/research/all/state/remote-work-tax-reform-mobility-modernization): Remote work tax reform policy analysis and recommendations

## Methodology & Research Frameworks

- [Economic and Tax Modeling](https://taxfoundation.org/topics/economic-and-tax-modeling): Guide to Tax Foundation's TAG macroeconomic modeling approach
